meta_data.base_class: Explore and find data related to current <domain trends> - refers to various fields where quantitative trends can be analyzed, such as product inventories or publication volumes across disciplines.

tool_template.name: Explore_<class>_data
tool_template.description: Explore and find data on current <class> trends.

include_case_studies.description: Whether to include case studies related to the <class> trends.

data_granularity.description: The level of detail in the <class> data, such as 'daily', 'monthly', or 'yearly'.

region_of_interest.description: The specific geographic region to focus on when exploring <class> trends.

historical_depth.description: The number of years back in time to explore <class> trends.

forecast_horizon.description: The number of months into the future for which to forecast <class> trends.

data_source.description: The primary source from which to gather <class> data, such as 'government reports', 'market surveys', or 'academic journals'.
